create_auto_router: create an AutoRouter instance with a semantic router to route requests to the appropriate model
load_semantic_routing_routes: load semantic routing routes from a JSON config file or inline config string
load_auto_router_routes_from_config_json: parse a JSON config string and build Route objects with name, description, utterances, and score threshold
run_async_pre_routing_hook: run the async pre-routing hook to select a model based on semantic route matching of user messages
review_auto_router_class: review the AutoRouter class and its semantic routing strategy for model selection
